libusbK redistributable driver binaries -- vendored for libwdi's embedder
===========================================================================

What this is: the signed libusbK.sys/.dll and libusb0 compatibility DLLs
that `third_party/libwdi`'s embedder step bakes into `libwdi.lib` at build
time (see `third_party/libwdi/NOTICE.txt`). These are the actual driver
payload libwdi installs on end-user machines via `wdi_install_driver`.

Provenance: extracted from this development machine's own Windows Driver
Store (`C:\Windows\System32\DriverStore\FileRepository\
libusbk_generic_device.inf_amd64_<hash>\`), where they had been installed
by Zadig 2.9 (https://github.com/pbatard/libwdi/releases) during earlier
manual driver-binding testing this project did (see docs/architecture.md's
Phase 7 AOA sections). Zadig itself vendors these exact files via the same
libwdi embedder mechanism -- this is the same signed libusbK package
libusbK's own project distributes, not a locally-built or modified driver.

Layout (matches libwdi's `embedder_files.h` LIBUSBK_DIR expectations,
x64-only -- see third_party/libwdi/NOTICE.txt for why x86/arm64 aren't
present):
  sys/amd64/libusbK.sys   -- the kernel-mode driver
  dll/amd64/libusbK.dll   -- the user-mode API DLL (64-bit)
  dll/amd64/libusb0.dll   -- libusb0 compatibility DLL (64-bit)
  dll/x86/libusbK.dll     -- 32-bit DLL, bundled inside the amd64 package
                             for reuse (embedder_files.h requires this even
                             in an x64-only build; never independently used)
  dll/x86/libusb0.dll     -- same, for libusb0

License: same as libusbK's own project (BSD-3-Clause per libusbK's usual
licensing; these binaries carry Microsoft catalog-signing, not a separate
license file of their own in this extraction -- see
https://github.com/mcuee/libusbk for upstream source and license text).

Not used at runtime by this repo directly -- only consumed by
`third_party/libwdi-src` at libwdi.lib build time (that source tree is not
committed to this repo; it's a build-time-only checkout, see
third_party/libwdi/NOTICE.txt's "Rebuilding" section).
